features.name: Node model
features.notes: Node, Edge, Handle, Viewport, Connection, FitViewOptions, changes implemented in Kotlin commonMain.

features.name: applyNodeChanges/applyEdgeChanges
features.notes: Common change helpers available in compose-flow model package.

features.name: Pan and wheel zoom
features.notes: Compose runtime supports pan, wheel zoom, programmatic fit and center.

features.name: Keyboard zoom
features.notes: Supported by host/editor integrations; not yet a built-in generic shortcut policy.

features.name: Fit view
features.notes: Generic fitViewport math is implemented in runtime.

features.name: Node rendering
features.notes: Composable node content with custom render styles supported.

features.name: Edge rendering
features.notes: Bezier and orthogonal path rendering supported.

features.name: Panels, minimap, background
features.notes: Generic panels, minimap, controls and background overlays implemented.

features.name: React Flow JS facade
features.notes: JS bridge and Karakum externals exist, but parity is incomplete.

features.name: Store hooks and advanced utilities
features.notes: React Flow provider/store parity and advanced system utilities remain to be added.

features.name: Node resizer / viewport portal parity
features.notes: ViewportPortal exists in Compose, NodeResizer parity is not implemented.
